dialogues.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
dialogues.text: Ha! The clear speed was even faster this time! Nice!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Are you also participating in the Nilotpala Cup? How could you not know who I am...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: An empty-headed outsider with a flying white mushroom... Pfft... You guys look so weak!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Wait, I don't think that's a mushroom... Ah well, makes no difference.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, you're a shroom buddy now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not the point! Argh, she is so cocky!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: What are you talking about? This is what you would call an intimidating aura!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I, Ajilenakh Dash, was the first to become an adult in the Ajilenakh Nut Gang! My lackeys all look up to me!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I work the fastest, earn money the fastest, read the fastest, and run the fastest. I'm faster than everyone else...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you eat Ajilenakh Nuts the fastest too?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: That's right! Everyone tells me that I can eat Ajilenakh Nuts as fast as lightning! If there was an Ajilenakh Nut eating contest, I'd win it even after drinking a couple tanks of water!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haha, what a straightforward nickname. But it looks like you're the one that's empty-headed!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: You! I've got my eyes on you, Flying White Mushroom! Just make sure you don't start bawling when I defeat you!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Then again, I might forget who you guys are by then. After all, there are so many people in the competition, and you guys hardly make an impression!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Just pray that you don't cross paths with me, Ajilenakh Dash, or you'll be beaten into the ground by my Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Arghh!!! We should've definitely used those two awesome nicknames!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: That's right! My Fungi and I have come up with a speedy strategy that can't be beaten!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: On my command, my Fungi will immediately swarm the opponent, and there's no way out of it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, isn't that the same as blindly charging at your opponent?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If there's a mismatch in overall strength, wouldn't you just lose immediately?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Wh—What are you talking about!? Everyone's Fungi have relatively the same strength. It's obvious whoever's faster will win!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Stories of instantly defeating four opponents of the same skill level only exist in fairy tales!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Flying White Mushroom, I dare you to try next time if you don't believe me.

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: You're all just... extra practice for me before I become champion anyway!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are quite a few contenders! Paimon wouldn't bet on us remembering who you are either!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, there's nothing to gain from beating you... Paimon really can't find any motivation...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Heh! Assuming you can beat me, even though it's highly unlikely, I'd be willing to recognize your strength and treat you to some most delicious Candied Ajilenakh Nuts!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? The most delicious Candied Ajilenakh Nuts? Paimon wonders how they taste...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Hmph, speak for yourself! Don't get yourself hurt!
